name: ES-CL Overlap Window Correlation
description: Rolling 60-bar Pearson correlation between ES and CL 5-min returns during the US/EU overlap window (8:00-11:30 AM ET). Tracks how equity-energy co-movement evolves intraday during peak liquidity hours. Event markers flag correlation breakdowns (crosses below zero).
source:
# ES-CL Rolling Correlation During US/EU Overlap (8:00-11:30 ET)
# 60-bar rolling Pearson on 5-min returns
# Anchored to ES; CL loaded as reference

# --- Data ---
ts = index().value

# ES: primary asset
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# CL: reference futures
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Returns ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl.c))

# --- Session: US/EU Overlap 8:00-11:30 ET ---
overlap = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c)

# --- Rolling Correlation (computed on all bars, filtered to overlap) ---
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(es_ret, cl_ret).result

# Filter to overlap window only
overlap_corr = where(overlap.active, corr_60)

# Session-end snapshot (last bar of overlap window each day)
eod_corr = where(overlap.closed, corr_60)

# --- Breakdown Detection: correlation crosses below zero during overlap ---
corr_breakdown = crossunder(corr_60, 0)
is_breakdown = is_valid(overlap_corr) and corr_breakdown

# --- Output 1: Correlation Time Series ---
xy_lines(
    title='How Correlated Are ES and CL During Peak Hours?',
    category='ES-CL Overlap',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Rolling Corr', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Moderate'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Inverse')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative'),
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Positive')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=overlap_corr)

# --- Output 2: Event Markers for Correlation Breakdowns ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Correlation Breakdown',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(corr_60, es.c, ffill(cl.c), is_breakdown)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Session-End Correlation Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='ES-CL Overlap',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overlap Session-End Correlation Stats',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Extremes', 'Reliability'],
        col_headers=['Metric', 'Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Median session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       info='Number of overlap sessions'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Worst session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Best session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Mean session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Std dev of session-end correlation')
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr)
